description.en: Complete enterprise growth diagnosis framework with city-tier intelligence and system loop analysis. Starts with 2 quick questions (city + industry), then auto-predicts market environment based on city tier. Features system loop diagrams (reinforcing/balancing), founder role evolution path, rent-vs-labor assessment, and lag-effect warnings. Through industry diagnosis → founder capability assessment → rapid scan → deep diagnosis → solution output, identify growth bottlenecks for SMEs and deliver actionable growth plans.
description.zh: 企业增长诊断框架（含城市线级智能预判+系统回路分析）。2问开场（城市+行业）自动预判市场环境，新增系统回路图（增强/调节）、创始人角色进化路径、企业租评估、滞后效应预警。通过完整流程识别中小企业增长瓶颈，输出可落地的增长方案。

name.zh: 绩效沟通双向诊断系统

description.en: A dual-directional diagnosis system for Chinese workplace performance communication. Based on local high-context communication rules, it provides complete analysis including subtext decoding, bidirectional superior-subordinate diagnosis, actionable management suggestions, and turnover risk early-warning.
description.zh: 专为中国职场打造，基于本土高语境沟通规则，针对一对一绩效沟通文本，完成潜台词解码、上下级双向诊断、落地管理建议、流失风险预警全流程分析。
